items.text: Arizona (final report): OUT: RG Jon Gaines II (ankle), DL Walter Nolen III (ankle). QUESTIONABLE: OL Hjalte Froholdt (knee, DNP Friday), CB Max Melton, S Andrew Wingard. RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) practiced fully and has no designation.
